calibration_rule: arrival960ms retained; private report delay nearest10ms median venue execution→Core report from3 older trials; cancel520ms assumption retained; no holdout fitting
passive_queue: displayed same-price size ahead; advances only on public opposing trades; unvalidated and excluded from a full fidelity PASS
covered_class: Every simulated order must fill completely against available-at fresh depth on arrival; no dropping adverse live/simulated groups
funding: public settled fundingHistory rate and last public oracle available before settlement <=2s old, signed truncation to1e-6 USDC, own simulated inventory at settlement
cash_gate: independent actual ledger vs Core/report and own simulated executions vs Core; not a promise of exact market-model PnL
first_run_guard: stop after15min on lifecycle failure or quantitative FAIL; retain INCONCLUSIVE and continue second frozen run; no retuning
clock_policy: physical venue book/trade events on exchange time; agent quote/bar visibility on receive time; simulated private reports delayed separately; no private actual fills as inputs
source_of_v1_failure: Prior holdouts remain FAIL: HTTP interruption; exact/display PnL bug; partial-fill dust topup. Recovery attempts and results are recorded separately.
changes_before_new_holdout: live target preflight refuses below-USD10 opening delta without an intent or blind retry; pure reduction remains allowed
cold replay has the identical minimum/refusal policy; no refitting of any clock, fee or numerical acceptance threshold
